name: Digi Report
author: digiperforma.com.br

sections.description:
“Digi Report” is a powerful tool for agencies and site administrators. It automates the collection of important data about site activity, security, and traffic, sending a clear, professional report to configured email addresses.

With this plugin, you can track:
* Maintenance: New posts, content updates, plugin updates, and WordPress core updates.
* Security: Number of Spam comments blocked automatically.
* Performance: Integration with “Independent Analytics” to show Views, Visitors, Top Pages, and Top Cities.
* Communication: Add a custom message to the monthly email header.

Simply set the day of the month for the report to be sent and keep your clients or team effortlessly informed about the site’s maintenance activities.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the digi-report folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ > ‘DigiReport’ to configure the destination email and the sending day.
  4. (Optional) Install the “Independent Analytics” plugin to unlock traffic data in your reports.
sections.faq:
The email is not arriving, what should I do?

First, check if your server’s email sending settings are working correctly. You can use a plugin like “WP Mail SMTP” to configure an external sending service to ensure reliable delivery.

How do I see traffic data?

You need to have the free plugin “Independent Analytics” installed and active. Digi Report automatically detects it and adds the data to the report.
